title: behen oleraceum
intro: Behen oleraceum, commonly known as Elephant Creeper or Wild Banyan, is a woody climber native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Behen oleraceum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, fever reduction, and anti-diarrheal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
